import json
root=Path('/Users/wangye/Documents/Codex/2026-10-02/wo')
game=root/'outputs/sticker-framework'
catalog=json.loads((game/'assets/town/catalog.json').read_text())
assets={a['id']:a for a in catalog['assets']}
rows=[json.loads((root/f'work/framework/town-{part}-layout.json').read_text()) for part in ['upper','middle','lower']]
items=[];regions=[];used=set();adjustments=[]
for row in rows:
    owner={item_id:r['key'] for r in row['regions'] for item_id in r['ids']}
    mapping={}
    for item in row['items']:
        source=item['id'];uid=source if source not in used else owner[source]+'__'+source
        assert uid not in used
        used.add(uid);mapping[source]=uid
    for item in row['items']:
        source=item['id'];a=assets[source];target=dict(item['target'])
        assert all(isinstance(target[k],(int,float)) for k in ['x','y','w','h'])
        assert target['w']>0 and target['h']>0
        # A copied PNG may have transparent padding; keep even that padding on the page.
        for axis,size,limit in [('x','w',1672),('y','h',941)]:
            if target[axis]<0 or target[axis]+target[size]>limit:
                old=target[axis];target[axis]=max(0,min(limit-target[size],target[axis]))
                adjustments.append({'id':mapping[source],'axis':axis,'from':old,'to':target[axis]})
        items.append({'id':mapping[source],'assetId':source,'name':a['name'],
            'image':'./assets/town/'+a['file'],'crop':[0,0,*a['native_size_px']],
            'target':target,'z':item['z'],'dependencies':[mapping.get(dep,dep) for dep in item.get('dependencies',[])]})
    for region in row['regions']:
        ids=[mapping[id] for id in region['ids']]
        selected=[item for item in items if item['id'] in ids]
        b=region['bounds'];x=max(0,min([b['x']]+[p['target']['x']-12 for p in selected]));y=max(0,min([b['y']]+[p['target']['y']-12 for p in selected]))
        right=min(1672,max([b['x']+b['w']]+[p['target']['x']+p['target']['w']+12 for p in selected]))
        bottom=min(941,max([b['y']+b['h']]+[p['target']['y']+p['target']['h']+12 for p in selected]))
        regions.append({'key':region['key'],'name':region['name'],'bounds':{'x':x,'y':y,'w':right-x,'h':bottom-y},'ids':ids})
assert len(items)==len(used)
assert {id for r in regions for id in r['ids']}==used
for item in items:
    assert all(dep in used for dep in item['dependencies'])
